resources.string: Rows show the Nutri-Score already saved on this phone for their product. The list never looks anything up.
Rows whose saved product lists one of these say so. Your choices stay on this phone: they are never synced, shared, exported or backed up.
Open Food Facts is community-contributed and may be incomplete. A row without a flag is not a promise: always check the packaging.
Allergens not stated, check the packaging.
